BrochureContent.Content:
Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 17 Collegefort to the Castleknock property market.

This two-bedroom own-door apartment comes to the market in excellent condition offering bright, well-proportioned accommodation in the heart of Castlenock.  

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a private entrance hallway with convenient storage, setting the tone for the quality and practicality found throughout the home.  To the front of the property, a bright and contemporary living room offers a warm yet elegant space to relax and unwind. Adjacent to the living area is a well-appointed kitchen, designed to maximise storage and workspace. The apartment boasts two generous bedrooms, including a well-sized primary bedroom featuring its own en-suite bathroom for added privacy and convenience, while a main bathroom completes the accomodation.

The location is second to none, offering a wide range of amenities to suit every lifestyle. Castleknock Village, home to an array of shops, cafés, and restaurants, is just a short stroll away, providing a vibrant community atmosphere. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Phoenix Park is located just 500 metres from the property. Blanchardstown Shopping Centre is also close by, offering extensive retail and dining options. Commuters are well catered for with excellent transport links, including multiple bus routes and Castleknock Train Station, providing swift and convenient access to Dublin City Centre and beyond.
